test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In June 2022, Eknath Sambhaji Shinde became the Chief Minister of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Eknath Shinde was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra on June 30, 2022.
 
• He succeeded Uddhav Thackeray, who resigned following a political crisis in the state.
 
• Eknath Shinde is a senior leader of the Shiv Sena party.
 
• He has previously served as the Cabinet Minister of Urban Development and Public Works (Public Undertakings) in the Maharashtra Government.
 
• The Deputy Chief Minister, Devendra Fadnavis, was also sworn in on the same day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shiv Sena Party**

 
 
• Founded in 1966 by Bal Thackeray, it is a right-wing Marathi regional political party.
 
• The party's primary base is in the state of Maharashtra.
 
• Shiv Sena advocates for the rights of the Marathi people and promotes the use of Marathi language.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra Political Crisis 2022**
 
 
• The political turmoil began when Eknath Shinde led a faction of Shiv Sena MLAs to rebel against Uddhav Thackeray's leadership.
 
• This led to Uddhav Thackeray's resignation as Chief Minister on June 29, 2022.
 
 
 
• **Devendra Fadnavis**
 
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Previously served as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra from 2014 to 2019.
 
• Currently, he serves as the Deputy Chief Minister under Eknath Shinde's leadership.
 
 
 
• **Urban Development in Maharashtra**
 
 
• Maharashtra is one of India's most urbanized states, with Mumbai being the financial capital of the country.
 
• The state government focuses on infrastructure development, housing, and public transportation to support urban growth.
